page_title: DRC 3-1 UZB | D.R. Congo v Uzbekistan 27/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Felix Zwayer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Abdukodir Khusanov (Uzbekistan) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Felix Zwayer no option but to blow his whistle.
90+6' Theo Bongonda (D.R. Congo) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
90+5' Ngalayel Mukau (D.R. Congo) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
90+3' Jamshid Iskanderov (Uzbekistan) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+1' 3 - 1 Goal! Yoane Wissa (D.R. Congo) is teed up on the edge of the box by Meschack Elia, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 3:1.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Fiston Mayele (D.R. Congo) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
85' The attendance is 68239.
83' A substitution has been made. Arthur Masuaku goes off and Joris Kayembe (D.R. Congo) comes on.
82' Fabio Cannavaro prepares a substitution. Akmal Mozgovoy is replaced by Jamshid Iskanderov (Uzbekistan).
82' It's time for a substitution. Igor Sergeev (Uzbekistan) comes on in place of Jakhongir Urozov.
78' 2 - 1 Goal! Meschack Elia takes aim and his effort deflects off Fiston Mayele (D.R. Congo) to beat the goalkeeper. 2:1.
75' Fiston Mayele (D.R. Congo) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
74' Theo Bongonda (D.R. Congo) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
74' Theo Bongonda (D.R. Congo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. D.R. Congo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

66' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle after Abdukodir Khusanov (Uzbekistan) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee gives a penalty kick to D.R. Congo!!

62' Samuel Moutoussamy (D.R. Congo) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
61' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Yoane Wissa (D.R. Congo) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.

58' Nathanael Mbuku (D.R. Congo) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Abduvakhid Nematov was alert and the score remains the same.
57' Akmal Mozgovoy (Uzbekistan) is able to continue to play.

43' Abdukodir Khusanov (Uzbekistan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
42' Nathanael Mbuku (D.R. Congo) sends the corner into the box, but Abduvakhid Nematov intercepts it and averts the threat.
42' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (D.R. Congo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. It will be a corner kick for D.R. Congo.
41' Dangerous play by Dostonbek Khamdamov (Uzbekistan). Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.

38' Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
35' Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

33' 56:44 – the ratio of ball possession.

27' The resulting corner, taken by Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan), comes to nothing.
23' A cooling break is underway.

17' Goal! Brian Cipenga finds Nathanael Mbuku (D.R. Congo) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the left side of the goal. Fantasy football! 1:1.
15' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle after Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
14' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and it's Jakhongir Urozov (Uzbekistan) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
13' Khozhiakbar Alizhonov (Uzbekistan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Uzbekistan are going to take it.
10' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! Akmal Mozgovoy found Eldor Shomurodov (Uzbekistan) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Lionel Mpasi-Nzau off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
